mainEntity.name: How long does a private property accident claim typically take in California?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a private property accident claim in California can vary significantly, ranging from a few months to several years. Factors influencing this timeline include the complexity of the case, the severity of your injuries, the willingness of the at-fault party to negotiate, and the court's schedule if a lawsuit is filed. Cases that settle out of court are generally resolved faster than those that proceed to trial. An experienced lawyer can provide a more accurate estimate based on the specifics of your situation and help expedite the process where possible.
acceptedAnswer.description: The duration of a private property accident claim in California varies, from months to years, depending on complexity, injury severity, and whether it settles or goes to trial.
